name: web-harvest
description: The retrieval router for the open web: search, scrape, crawl, and structured extraction at scale. One skill classifies the job and routes it across Firecrawl, Exa, Tavily, Bright Data, and Apify, climbing a cost-aware escalation ladder and stopping at the first backend that returns real data. All five backends are hosted HTTP connectors, so the plugin holds no local process.
